structured.answer: Open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D). Both are marked "הזול", with only 1,057 ₪ in account fees over 10 years. With 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years at 7% you end up with about 86,492 ₪ "בכסף של היום", but I couldn't see the figure for my own 30,000.

stuck.why: Wanted to enter my 30,000 but the page's example uses 10,000; it's a screenshot so I couldn't change it, and I didn't know what my result would be
Saw −43, −213, −447, −1,268 and read them as losses; wasn't sure what they meant
'בין +2,212 ל־−23,766' range scared me; didn't understand it

stuck.why: Lost me completely; stopped scrolling here
I trust the big banks more, and the page ranks my bank lower; not sure how to open a פסגות account

findings.what: The example amount (10,000) isn't mine and there's no easy way to type my own, so the big number doesn't fit my situation
The fund comparison column shows minus shekel numbers (−447, −1,268) that look like losing money
Every fund has 4–5 coloured jargon tags (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מס גם על שינוי המטבע) and they're noise to me
No 'what to do now' step: it says which account is cheapest but not how to open it and buy
'בכסף של היום' under the big number isn't explained, so I can't tell if 86,492 is real shekels or adjusted
Big banks I trust are ranked lower, and the cheapest is a broker account I'm less sure about
The currency-hedged fund shows a wide range down to −23,766 ₪, which is scary and not explained
The chart with 4 coloured lines and a legend is hard to read on a phone
